scenarios.name: cross-compile-static-binary
scenarios.rationale: Both responses fully satisfy the rubric, providing loops that set GOOS/GOARCH, enable CGO_ENABLED=0, use go build with -trimpath and the required ldflags, and output binaries named with OS-ARCH suffixes.
